summary_en: Toda Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 8.0 million shares (2.7% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥10.0 billion through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 16, 2026 and February 28, 2027. All acquired shares are planned for cancellation to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns under the DOE 3.5% policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Share Buyback (Acquisition of Treasury Shares Based on Articles of Incorporation Provisions under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Toda Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 8.0 million ordinary shares, representing 2.7% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares), for a maximum total consideration of ¥10.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

The company intends to cancel all acquired shares. This buyback supports Toda's shareholder return policy outlined in its Medium-Term Management Plan 2027, which targets a DOE of 3.5% or higher with an overall shareholder payout ratio of approximately 70%. The company views this share reduction as a means to improve capital efficiency and deliver enhanced returns to shareholders through a lower equity base.
